# Search Console (generated, do not edit)

Read 2026-11-26T19:00 UTC for sc-domain:freshcalendars.com. Windows end 3 days before the read (Search Console data is late). Source: `scripts/news-gsc.mjs`, daily. Web, image and Discover results are separate: each section says which.

## Gate for the phase decision (docs/DESK.md)

- PASS: At least 60% of /news/ URLs published 7 to 21 days ago are indexed — 100% (70 of 70 sampled)
- FAIL: /news/ clicks and impressions did not fall two weeks in a row — fell two weeks in a row: clicks, impressions
- CHECK: No manual action and no security issue — not in the API: check Search Console > Security & Manual Actions
